landing_faq_description: A few useful things before you start. No promises hidden in the small print.
landing_faq_services_question: Do I have to enable every service?
landing_faq_services_answer: No. At each location you can choose pickup, delivery, reservations and table QR orders independently. Configure what suits the way you work.
landing_faq_website_question: Can I publish a menu without a website?
landing_faq_website_answer: ZionFood includes a public menu with your restaurant’s identity. You do not need to build a separate website for that menu. A custom domain requires separate configuration.
landing_faq_qr_question: How do I stay in control of QR ordering?
landing_faq_qr_answer: Each table has a permanent QR code. Staff can close and reopen its menu. Ordering stops before venue closing according to your chosen cutoff, such as 30 or 60 minutes.
landing_faq_payments_question: Can I collect online payments now?
landing_faq_payments_answer: Not yet. Online payment processing and reservation deposits are in preparation. The Payments menu is currently informational and does not collect payments.
landing_faq_start_answer: Create an account and follow the guided setup for your restaurant, tables, menu and services. Onboarding includes a 14-day trial. The interface is available in Romanian and English.
